assumptions: nlpd-iqa = nlpd::iqa::score_rgb_u8 (iqa.rs:41-72 -> score_planes 122-148, iqa_level 156-185). Requires W,H >= 96. BT.709 Y on [0,1] quantized to the u8 grid (round(Y*255)/255).
Ingress per px per img (iqa.rs:113-119 + simd::y709_grid): 3 cvt + mul3 + add2 + round/quantize (~2 ops: mul+round+div -> fma+cvt) + store.

6 pyramid levels; level dims ceil/2 per axis. Per level per image: downsample = reflect-pad2 + stride-2 LOWPASS [0.05,0.25,0.4,0.25,0.05] 5-tap: h pass 5 mul + 4 add per out elem over (ow x h), v pass 5 mul + 4 add over ow x oh (iqa.rs:163-168, lib.rs:401-537).

normalize_filtered (simd.rs:390-596): fused per-row ring computing bilinear-upsample->5x5-smooth->nearest-crop->subtract->divisive-normalize with no materialized planes. Per output elem (level grid): upsample lerp ~ mul3 add2 (hlerp + row blend amortized), h5 filter mul5 add4, v5 fma5, subtract 1, normalize denom = sigma + sum(4 DN taps x |lap|) -> abs4 + mul4 + add4, final div 1; loads ~17.
Odd-dim overshoot path (uw>w) materializes smooth row + gather; counted via same per-elem class (nearest gather adds ~1 load).
Per level joint: squared_difference f64 fma-accum over w*h (iqa.rs:132-136, simd.rs:4-27): sub+fma+2 loads per elem, then sqrt(sq/n) once per level.
Score = mean of 6 per-level RMS values.

fused upsample+5x5 smooth+crop+sub+normalize
stages.notes: lerp(mul3 add2) + h5(mul5 add4) + v5(fma5) + sub1 + denom(abs4 mul4 add4) + div1
